The league's title sponsor was the e-commerce website 58.com.[https://sports.sina.com.cn/b/2015-03-13/20257541489.shtml 中甲获2015–19年冠名权] The season began on 9 March and concluded on 2 November.{{cite web|url=https://sports.sina.com.cn/china/j/2018-12-20/doc-ihmutuee0902417.shtml|title=19年赛历:跨9个月5次间歇期 足协杯决赛间隔1个月|work=Sina Sports|date=2018-12-20|access-date=2018-12-20|language=zh}} Policy regarding foreign players and U-23 domestic players was modified in this season. The same as the previous two seasons, at least one domestic player who is under the age of 23 (born on or after 1 January 1996) must be in the starting eleven. However, the total number of foreign players appearing in matches is no longer related to the total number of U-23 domestic players. A club can register three foreign players at most in the same time and use two foreign players at most in a match. On the other hand, at least two U-23 domestic players must be used in a match. In addition, if there are U23 players who have been called up by the national teams at all levels, the number of U-23 domestic players fielded will be reduced accordingly.{{cite web|url=https://sports.sina.com.cn/china/b/2018-12-20/doc-ihmutuee0935074.shtml|title=中甲改制：2020年扩至18队 U23需两人次+引入VAR|work=Sina Sports|date=2018-12-20|access-date=2018-12-20|language=zh}} In order to
